text.description_html:
Falcon 1492NL-OP, Concealed Vertical Rod Touchbar Device With Night Latch Cylinder

With a night latch, a key retracts the latch but does not unlock exit device. The Concealed Vertical Rod Touchbar Device With Night Latch Cylinder, is for 36" x 84" aluminum or hollow metal doors. It comes with a RL Bottom Latch. A "C" keyway rim cylinder is supplied. The 1490 is built with rugged steel operating mechanisms along with durable aluminum push bars and end caps. 1490 High Security devices are used for hurricane rated door openings.

Features and Specifications of the Falcon Concealed Vertical Panic Device:

  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Doors Thickness: 1-3⁄4" thick metal doors.
  • Door Width: Up to 36"
  • Minimum Door Size: 25-3 ⁄4"
    • Projection: 2-3⁄4" maximum, 2" when dogged.
  • Pushbar Height: 3".
  • Stile Width: 1-3⁄4" minimum.
  • Door Height: Up to 84" (7 Ft)
  • Dogging: Hex key dogging standard
  • Certified ANSI A156.3 grade 1 standards.
  • Strikes: PB48 top.
  • Fasteners:All mounting screws are concealed. Uses all machine screws for device and latch.
  • End Caps: Durable zinc die cast, powder coated.

Sold Individually
